summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in run()'s run_app try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests; all pass on the recorded venv (Python 3.9.25) when run with PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src, because the venv's editable install points textual at a separate base/src checkout. Nothing committed. Not verified: existing async test modules fail with "async def functions are not natively supported" because the venv lacks pytest-asyncio; full suite and other Python versions not run.
